messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to coordinate merges across repos: SDK PR needs to land before API and Console. Plan: merge today during the 16:00-17:00 PT canary window. Who can own approvals and watch CI?
Ben: I can take API review. LGTM once SDK tag is published. Will wait to approve until the SDK merge triggers the tag. :eyes:
Alex: Console PR depends on the new SDK client interface, so it's blocked until the SDK tag is pushed. I can queue console review now and hold final approval.
Priya: SDK PR needs one more unit test and a changelog line — I can push a tiny fix in ~20-30m. CI was flaky earlier (windows runner), I'll re-run after the patch.
Maya: Perfect. Order we'll do: SDK -> API -> Console -> Helm image tag bump. Also staging integration tests start at 17:30 PT, so try to finish merges by 17:00.
Ben: Sounds good. CI will publish a tag on merge, correct? If so I'll approve API after tag appears. :thumbsup:
Priya: Yes CI will publish. Pushing the test/fix now.
CI-bot: build/sdks triggered, build/api queued, lint checks pending.
Priya: pushed fix, re-run CI.
CI-bot: build/sdks passed, build/api lint passed, api integration queued.
Ben: Approved API#540 — merging now. I'll monitor tag publish.
CI-bot: api merged by Ben; CI published sdk-client v1.6.0.
Priya: SDK PR updated to use v1.6.0 and CI re-run.
CI-bot: build/sdks passed. SDK merged by Priya.
Alex: Updated console to use the new client tag, running local e2e. If green I'll request final review.
Alex: e2e passed locally. Console ready for review; requesting final approval from @Ben.
Ben: Quick look — small nit but not blocking. Approved. Merging console now.
CI-bot: console merged by Alex.
Maya: I'll open the helm PR to bump the runtime image tag and run helm test after merge. ETA ~10m.
Maya: helm PR opened -> charts/runtime#45. Can someone sanity-check values? Particularly resource requests and imagePullPolicy.
Ben: Quick glance looks fine. :+1:
CI-bot: helm lint passed. charts merged by Maya.
Maya: Thanks everyone — staging integration run starting now. If anything breaks, ping #eng-oncall. Great coordination, especially on the tag handoff. :tada:
